# EduExpress International

> Evidence-first study abroad consultancy for students and families in Bangladesh, based in Dhanmondi, Dhaka since 2018. EduExpress compares education quality, recognition, the full cost and visa readiness before recommending a route, puts every cost in writing, and charges no service fee for China before the student's visa is approved. Admission, scholarship and visa outcomes are never guaranteed.

Key facts:
- Founded 8 March 2018 by Abdullah Al Rakib (Founder and CEO); China specialist with 12 destination services.
- Office: Evergreen Latif, House 12/1, Road 4/A, Ground Floor, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1209, Bangladesh. Open Saturday to Thursday, 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +880 1983-333566, +880 1329-663505. Email: info@eduexpressint.com
- Free first assessment. Fees, inclusions and refund terms: https://eduexpressint.com/pricing.md
- Full reference with guide answers, intakes and the university directory: https://eduexpressint.com/llms-full.txt

## Start here

- [Free education fit assessment](https://eduexpressint.com/education-fit-assessment): share results, budget and goals; a counsellor replies within one working day
- [Fees and transparency](https://eduexpressint.com/fees-and-transparency): what EduExpress charges, when, and what is paid to third parties
- [China visa-first payment policy](https://eduexpressint.com/china-visa-first-policy): no service fee before China visa approval
- [Contact and office visit](https://eduexpressint.com/contact): address, hours, phone, WhatsApp and map

## Study in China (flagship)

- [Study in China from Bangladesh](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-from-bangladesh): the complete starting guide
- [Cost of studying in China](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-cost-bangladesh): tuition, hostel, insurance, visa and travel budgeting
- [China scholarships](https://eduexpressint.com/china-scholarships-bangladesh): CSC, provincial and university awards and what they cover
- [CSC scholarship from Bangladesh](https://eduexpressint.com/csc-scholarship-bangladesh): Chinese Government Scholarship steps and documents
- [China admission requirements](https://eduexpressint.com/china-admission-requirements): documents and entry rules by level
- [China student visa (X1/X2)](https://eduexpressint.com/china-student-visa-bangladesh): visa preparation from Bangladesh
- [Study in China without IELTS](https://eduexpressint.com/study-in-china-without-ielts): English-proof routes that are accepted
- [MBBS in China](https://eduexpressint.com/mbbs-in-china-bangladesh): medical universities, fees and BMDC considerations
- [China intakes and deadlines](https://eduexpressint.com/china-intakes-deadlines): March and September 2027 windows with live status
- [Life in China for Bangladeshi students](https://eduexpressint.com/life-in-china-bangladeshi-students): housing, food, safety and part-time rules
- [China universities](https://eduexpressint.com/china-universities): profiles with programmes, fees and scholarships
- [বাংলা গাইড (Bengali guide)](https://eduexpressint.com/bn/study-in-china): study in China, in Bengali

## Plan and compare

- [University and programme finder](https://eduexpressint.com/universities): search universities by subject, level, intake and scholarship
- [China program and tuition finder](https://eduexpressint.com/programs): every recorded China programme filtered by yearly tuition, language, city and deadline
- [Compare first-year costs](https://eduexpressint.com/compare-costs): up to three China programmes side by side, fee by fee
- [Scholarship guidance and database](https://eduexpressint.com/scholarships): what awards cover, plus a searchable list of recorded China scholarships
- [All destinations](https://eduexpressint.com/destinations): China, United Kingdom, South Korea, Malaysia, Hungary, Finland, Cyprus, Croatia, Georgia, Malta, Greece, Thailand
- [Compare study destinations](https://eduexpressint.com/compare-study-destinations): cost and entry side by side
- [Your study journey](https://eduexpressint.com/your-study-journey): the seven stages from assessment to arrival
- [For parents](https://eduexpressint.com/for-parents): costs, safety and responsibilities explained for families
